subject: general
question: In which year was the Export-Import (EXIM) Bank of India established?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1982.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank) was set up in 1982 India by an Act of Parliament and It is fully owned by the Government of India.
 
• Exim Bank was set up in 1982 in India **for the purpose of financing, facilitating and promoting India's foreign trade**.
 
• It is the principal financial institution in India for coordinating the working of institutions engaged in financing exports and imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Harsha Bangari is the CEO of Exim Bank in India as of the year 2022.
 
• **Exim Bank was established **as a purveyor of export credit, mirroring global Export Credit Agencies.
 
• Exim Bank serves as a growth engine for industries and SMEs through a wide range of products and services.
